name: Besiege
short_description: Build medieval siege machines from blocks and hinges, then send them to wreck castles and armies.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Build medieval siege machines from blocks and hinges, then send them to wreck castles and armies.

identity.core_loop: Bolt parts together, bind keys, test, watch it fall apart, rebuild better.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Joyful trial and error; physics is honest, failure is funny.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: The machine is the readout: it wobbles, snaps and tips over in the world. Very little screen interface beyond the parts bar.

identity.art_direction: Clean stylised low-poly fields and castles.

rendering.signature: Clean low-poly fields and castles with simple soft light so contraptions stay readable.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: Keep the world quiet so the thing the player builds is the loudest object.

identity.audio_mood: Light medieval tunes, creaks and crashes.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Let kids build, then test it in the world right away; the physics is the teacher. Evan's own reference.
